task.description:
Validate the ISS-0121 test design (hard gate before Step 5).

Hard-gate checks per CLAUDE.md §TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR:
1. Every MUST requirement has a runnable integration test. (ISS-0121 has no formal MUST requirement entry, but the handoff defines 7 TC cases; all must be implemented.)
2. No `error.SkipZigTest` on any test block in tests/integration/iss0121_uuid_helpers_test.zig.
3. All fixtures use per-test UUIDs (the helper itself IS the fixture-generation mechanism).
4. Tests clean up after themselves (defer blocks present).
5. Tests fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent.

Additional MAJOR — does not block PASS but must be noted:
6. ISS-0121 affects 17+ files; the regression suite tests the helper API but does NOT test the per-file migration end-to-end. Note this as MAJOR.
7. Pipeline check: ISS-0121 is NOT a sequential UI action requiring a pl.step(); note that this is N/A.

Concretely:

  python3 tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration

Verify exit code and confirm the new test file `iss0121_uuid_helpers_test.zig` produces 0 new T010 violations.

Confirm `zig build test-integration-iss0121` exit code by reading the spec or by simulating compilation: `zig build` (exit 0) ensures compile-only is fine; the test target was added in build.zig.

Inspect the spec file's content for GIVEN/WHEN/THEN style for all 7 TC cases.

Return PASS or FAIL with concrete issues.
acceptance_criteria: All 7 TC cases in ISS-0121.md have a corresponding `test "TC-ISS-0121-NN:` block in iss0121_uuid_helpers_test.zig
Zero new T010 violations introduced by the new test file

result.summary: ISS-0121 test design validated. All 7 TC cases (TC-ISS-0121-01..-07) are present in tests/specs/ISS-0121.md with GIVEN/WHEN/THEN structure, and all 7 corresponding test blocks are implemented in tests/integration/iss0121_uuid_helpers_test.zig with try testing.expect* assertions and no error.SkipZigTest. Lint baseline: 122 files checked, 0 new T010 findings attributable to iss0121_uuid_helpers_test.zig (BLOCKER=0 / MAJOR=243 baseline inherited from other test files / MINOR=0). zig build exits 0. SQL param-type lint: 0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR, 0 MINOR. Per-test isolation: TC-01..TC-06 use an uninitialised TestHarness (helpers _=self so it is safe); TC-07 uses TestHarness.init() which propagates error.MissingTestDatabaseUrl rather than swallowing it. Cleanup: defer alloc.free on every newUuidString result; defer h.deinit() on TC-07 rolls back the transaction.

issues.description: ISS-0121 affects 17+ migration files; the new regression suite pins the TestHarness helper API but does NOT execute an end-to-end migration of every affected file. Acceptable for the helper-API contract gate; the per-file end-to-end coverage is the responsibility of each subsequent file's dedicated integration test (which is also expected to migrate to the helper).
ISS-0121 is a backend refactor with no user-visible sequential UI action; Playwright pipeline pl.step() is N/A (per docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md §11.10). No pipeline file action required.
